test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six letters, D, E, F, G, H and I are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown here. Find the letter on the face opposite E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a08d0ff4c4b7841e6066006ef48662e71fe9bd6c6ef879d4927431c0e7fbeb5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6901dccc8b84c08408ddc4088ae13e1fe9a16c6780f1f0b941c55e6c9ae2b142.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As G is common on both the dices II and III, it is clear that F, E, D, and H are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. I will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f0517212848721538ef3ddd35a7d07fa4a8295909f42e0621c1fa31cf9b3bf6.png] 

Opposite pairs:

F → H

E → D

G → I

So, the opposite side of "E" will be side "D".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
